title: Braelon Allen didn’t sugercoat importance of his Jets season after injury — with simple goal in mind

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Braelon Allen didn’t sugercoat importance of his Jets season after injury — with simple goal in mind
sources.description: Allen didn’t sugarcoat the significance of the upcoming season. It’s incredibly important, after appearing in only four games last year due to a major knee injury.
